Ю. и Терников С. А.) were re-researched. Local documents: all 7 local MRKC PDFs (main annual report, MSFO statement, and 5 приложения к ГО) were re-scanned programmatically (PyMuPDF full-text search) for 'Земсков', 'Терников' and 'Шаркова'/'Шарков'; zero hits for all three, confirming round 1. Web research: the session WebSearch budget (200 of 200 calls) was already exhausted at the start of this round, so WebFetch was used instead on official pages, annual-report PDFs and search-engine result pages (Yandex, Bing/DuckDuckGo). For Земсков А. Ю., no reliable new fact was found; one search-engine-summarized snippet falsely attributed him a 'Head of IT Support Department' role citing an official PDF (RossetiCentre_BookOfAchievements_2022-2023.pdf) — this 99-page PDF was downloaded and checked programmatically in full and does not contain his name anywhere, so the claim was rejected as an unreliable/hallucinated search-summary artifact and not used. For Терников С. А., education remains unconfirmed, but one new fact was found and confirmed by direct programmatic PDF/page verification: he also heads the IR service of the sister company ПАО "Россети Центр и Приволжье" (ar2023.mrsk-cp.ru/additional-information/contacts), with the identical contact phone number as his ПАО "Россети Центр" IR role, corroborated by ar2022.mrsk-1.ru and rspp.ru/upload/uf/84e/Book_MRSK_C_AR_2018.pdf (both fetched and checked directly); this new professional_experience entry was added with sourcing. Two other leads for Терников were found but rejected/left unconfirmed and documented per-person: a broader job-title phrase from an unverifiable archive.org snippet (web.archive.org could not be fetched by the available tool this round to confirm it, and the same-era official PDF source does not corroborate the extended wording), and a NAUFOR securities-market exam-attestation record ('не сдан') for a same-named person that could not be confirmed as the same individual (rejected per the no-namesake-mixing rule and connection errors preventing direct verification). For Шаркова Ю. Э., the round-1 patronymic/identity conclusion (based on an official governing-body archive page match on full name, company and function) stands; no newer official page surfaced this round, and her absence from the local 2024 annual report was reconfirmed by the same programmatic full-text search. No fact was invented for any of the three; nulls/empty arrays were preserved per the prefer-null-over-an-unverified-guess rule. (2) Structural conversion: education, degrees and professional_experience were converted from plain narrative strings (this ticker's original round-1 format, unlike the already-object-structured format used by most other processed tickers including the sibling company FEES and the MRKP/MRKZ/MRKU/MRKV Rosseti-group tickers) into structured objects (institution/year/field/qualification/description for education; degree/institution/year/description for degrees; organization/role/start_year/end_year/description for professional_experience), preserving every fact, date and qualifying phrase from the original strings without deletion or invention; where one original bullet named two organizations with different GICS profiles (Саух М. М.: АО "ЕЭСК" и ООО "АйТи Энерджи Сервис"), it was split into two professional_experience entries so each could carry its own correct sector/industry_group/industry triple; where two organizations shared an identical GICS profile and only one combined date range was given in the source, they were kept in a single entry to avoid inventing unstated separate dates. Г.М. Кржижановского, a power-engineering research institute, confirmed by web research this round) equal Industrials/Commercial & Professional Services/Professional Services, by the same precedent already used in FEES round 3 for a comparable power-sector R&D institute (АО "НТЦ ФСК ЕЭС"); АО "ВОЛС ВЛ" (fiber-optic telecommunications-infrastructure operator on power-line towers, since 2022 branded АО "Россети Цифра", confirmed by web research this round) equal Communication Services/Telecommunication Services/Diversified Telecommunication Services. Set sector/industry_group/industry to null with justification for: the Вооруженные Силы РФ (military service, not a commercial organization); non-profit industry/business associations (НКО "Ассоциация профессиональных инвесторов", НП "Ассоциация профессиональных инвесторов", Ассоциация развития технологий систем накопления электроэнергии, Ассоциация организаций цифрового развития отрасли "Цифровая энергетика", Ассоциация ТЭК "Российский Национальный Комитет Мирового Энергетического Совета", РСПП, НП "Центр развития корпоративных отношений и разрешения экономических споров") — the same treatment already applied to comparable associations in other processed tickers such as CHMF/World Steel Association and FEES/Ассоциация Цифровая энергетика; ООО "Инфраструктурные Инвестиции-3" (a Rosseti-Centre-and-Volga-group investment SPV registered under the generic catch-all OKVED 82.99 'business support services not elsewhere classified', per this round's web research across several independent Russian company-registry aggregators — too generic to support a specific GICS bucket); and ППК "ВСК" (Военно-строительная компания, a non-commercial public-law company subordinate to the Ministry of Defence performing state-funded defence construction, confirmed by web research this round — treated as a non-GICS-classifiable governmental/non-commercial body, by the same principle already used in FEES round 2 for ministries and other government bodies, rather than defaulted into Construction & Engineering without support).
